title: Endpoints: the API routes that live beside the pages

videos.script:
Pages answer people. {{first}} Endpoints answer programs. A file called plus server dot js, and a function named after the HTTP method, returning a response.

The first one puts the planner's data back at the address it used to have. {{csv}} The second hands out a spreadsheet. It has to be careful how it writes the cells, because a cell that starts with an equals sign is a formula, and a spreadsheet will run it.

Then an endpoint that receives data. {{receive}} The check that the form uses moves into one place, so that the form and the endpoint can never disagree. And the endpoint refuses anything that is not JSON, for a reason you would not guess.

Then a page and an endpoint at the same address. {{negotiate}} The request says what it wants, and SvelteKit picks the file.

And last, {{which}} how to choose between an endpoint and a form action.
